name: Dopamine
subtitle: A rootless semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 15.0 - 18.7.1
description:
Dopamine is a rootless semi-untethered jailbreak for iOS 15.0 - 17.3.1 (arm64e), iOS 15.0 - 18.7.1 and 26.0 - 26.0.1 (A12/A13) and iOS 15.0 - 18.7.1 (arm64).

Official website: https://ellekit.space/dopamine/
Source code: https://github.com/opa334/Dopamine

Official website: https://ellekit.space/dopamine/
Source code: https://github.com/opa334/Dopamine

versions.localizedDescription: Expose an API to frida that allows it to hook memory over hookd, fixes panics when using frida on iOS 26+ (Requires frida >=17.19.0) (contributed by @devnoname120)
Fix jailbreak apps not being removed from home screen when removing the jailbreak on iOS 18.0 - 18.3.1 too
Fix jailbreak apps not being removed from home screen when removing the jailbreak on iOS 18.4+
Fix an OOB kernel write during the jbupdate process that could cause a panic and in some cases leave the file `/var/jb/basebin/gen/dyld.old` in a corrupted state where it cannot be deleted anymore...
Fix "Finalizing Bootstrap" sometimes failing with "code signature invalid" error when jailbreaking a device for the first time [3.0.5 regression]
Actually** fix random panics on TXM devices when something tries to load a dynamic trustcache (#893)
Fix missing post exploitation clean up if the jailbreak failed or is being removed
Fix support for iOS 18.2 to 18.(?) [3.0.2 regression]
Fix random panics on TXM devices when something tries to load a dynamic trustcache
Fix Titan not working on ARM_LARGE_MEMORY kernels (Mainly M1/M2 iPads)
Add Titan PPL/SPTM bypass by @alfiecg24, introduces support for all devices running 16.5.1 - 17.3.1
Fix support for iOS 17.1 - 17.3.1
Fix a logic bug in forkfix [2.4.8 regression]
Reflect that landa got patched in 15.8.7 (RIP) (Thanks @TheMasterOfMike for the PR)
Fix an issue where the jailbreaking process would get stuck on "Patchfinding" on some device / version combinations (seemingly affected early iOS 15 arm64 devices the most) [2.4.6 regression]
Add the ability to have the device display a boot logo during userspace reboots (By default the background of the selected theme will be used, additionally there is an option to select a custom one)
Revert compiler optimizations for libjailbreak since this broke 15.x arm64 support [2.4.4 regression]
Improve fix from 2.4.3 to also work in processes for which tweak injection has been disabled
Fix an issue where calling dlopen in a fork child would fail (on iOS 15) or crash the process (on iOS 16) (Fixes `perl` crashing when running `apt-file search <query>` on iOS 16) [2.4 regression]
Extend library validation bypass to also work when something manually invokes fcntl in the dyld_shared_cache
Fix support for iOS 16.0.x [2.4 regression]

Stop redirecting all `execve` calls to `posix_spawn`, fixes issues with certain sandbox profiles (e.g. `configd`) that block `posix_spawn` but allow `execve`, fixes WPA2/3 ENTERPRISE networks not...
Bump default jetsam multiplier back to 3x because apparently people don't read changelogs and that's why we can't have nice things (Most people should still be using 2x, but that's on their own to...
Remove `DYLD_INTERPOSE` in favor of other hooking techniques, since `DYLD_INTERPOSE` was apparently causing memory usage to be much higher than what it should be
Remove `libkrw0` dependency of libkrw plug-in, should fix rejailbreaking when `libkrw0` has been uninstalled
Fix jailbreaking with developer mode disabled not working on iOS 16.0 - 16.3.1 arm64

Allow binaries to get custom pmap_cs trust level via the `jb.pmap_cs_custom_trust` entitlement, possible values: {`"PMAP_CS_PROFILE_PREFLIGHT"`, `"PMAP_CS_COMPILATION_SERVICE"`, `"PMAP_CS_OOP_JIT"`...
Only automatically fix up permissions of relevant directories inside `/var/jb/var/mobile`, rather than the entirety of it
Fix app switcher not displaying preview images of jailbreak apps in some cases [2.1 regression]
Fix codesigning bypass failing on binaries/libraries that have an armv7s slice (Fixes Designer not working) [2.1 regression]
Add support for A8(X) devices

Fix jailbreaking not working when developer mode was disabled (Developer mode will now be automatically enabled in a non persistent way for the current boot)
